name: Camil Alimentos S.A.
summary: Camil Alimentos S.A., together with its subsidiaries, engages in processing, production, packaging, and marketing of food products. The company offers grains, sweeteners, canned sardines and tuna, pasta, coffee, biscuits, cookies, healthy products, and other products. It provides its products under Camil, Saman, La Abundancia, Tucapel, Costeno, Rico Arroz, and Villa Oliva brand names. The company was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil. Camil Alimentos S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Camil Investimentos S.A.
